## How Papers Are Organized

Each topic has its own sub-folder under `papers/computer-science/`. Inside a topic you'll find the area-level sub-folders (e.g. `Alignment/`, `Interpretability/`) and per-year READMEs that act as index files. The moment a paper lands in a topic folder with a matching `metadata.json`, the topic page lights up automatically.
